title: Zesty Roasted Croatian Shrimp Pilaf
description: A fresh and flavorful Croatian dish featuring roasted peanuts and shrimp, perfect for a lazy Sunday, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot and served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the pilaf rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the pilaf is cooking, roast the peanuts in the oven for 10 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the roasted peanuts and shrimp to the pilaf, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve the Zesty Roasted Croatian Shrimp Pilaf in a bento box.
